memoryBuilder.verseText: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name.

sequence.prompt: What happened at the Tower of Babel? Put it in order.

items.label: People plan to build a tower to heaven

matches.prompt: Match each to what it means.

pairs.right: Human pride — trying to be great without God
How the world's different nations began
Reaches DOWN to us — we don't reach UP to Him

application.question: People tried to reach God by being great. But God reaches DOWN to us through Jesus! What does God reaching down mean to you?

options.label: I don't need to be great to know God
God loves me just as I am
God is closer than I think

application.followUp: You can't build your way up to God — but God already came all the way down to you. That's what Jesus' whole life was about.
